title: Sales screen — three directions
brief: Redesign /sales of Tempox, a two-person shop's bookkeeping app, after the impeccable toolchain was retired. Same palette, same components, three different composition strategies; the current world ('The Computed Account Statement') is treated as an anti-reference, not authority.

artboards.title: El libro es la página
artboards.tradeoff: Best for reading and explaining the day: one document and one action, with the running balance in a gutter that never scrolls. During a burst of sales the draft is a strip rather than a workspace.

artboards.title: La mano izquierda es el contador
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest for the cashier and honest about who the page is for; the balance leaves the table for a fixed margin track. Spends width on the gutter and the narrow left column punishes long product names.

artboards.title: El borrador es el comprobante
artboards.tradeoff: Most legible per document and the most honest about what is being written; no table anywhere. Scanning a day of thirty slips is slower than thirty rows, and long names wrap.
